title: Temporal graph burning at edge-interval-membership width one
description:
Temporal Graph Burning under Hand’s thesis rules is NP-complete even on a connected underlying graph with one active time per edge and no active time shared by two edges. This yields para-NP-completeness with respect to edge-interval-membership width.

The reduction from Set Cover assigns one contact to each occupied timestep. A verified finite replay compares 246 schedules, and a worked visual explorer follows a 21-vertex example. The theorem is proved analytically. Internally reviewed. External peer review is pending.

ChatGPT Astra 6.2 (OpenAI) generated the recovered discovery proof and original replay under human direction. Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) assisted with earlier audits. OpenAI Codex checked the construction. GPT-6.2 Sol (OpenAI) checked the literature and prepared the reconstructed manuscript, exact replay, and illustration. DannyExperiments is the project citation identity.
